description: Count received messages matching the same search and filters as list_messages.

after.description: Received or sent at or after this time: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, optional 1–3 fractional digits, then Z or ±HH:mm.

before.description: Received or sent before this time: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, optional 1–3 fractional digits, then Z or ±HH:mm.

labels_all.description: Require every listed label. An empty array in any label filter adds no condition.

items.description: Case-sensitive label, trimmed; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

labels_any.description: Require at least one listed label.

items.description: Case-sensitive label, trimmed; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

labels_none.description: Exclude messages with any listed label.

items.description: Case-sensitive label, trimmed; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

query.description: Words or quoted phrases that must all appear in the subject or body. Case-insensitive keyword match, not semantic search; up to 16 terms or phrases.

recipient.description: Exact To, Cc or Bcc address, case-insensitive.

subject.description: Literal, case-insensitive substring of the subject.

title: Count received emails
